content.title:
Review a mock
*in 30 minutes.*
content.subtitle: The marks are in the review, not in the mock. Five steps.

steps.title: Sort every question
steps.detail: Mark each one: right, wrong, skipped or guessed.

steps.title: Wrongs first
steps.detail: For each wrong answer, write one line: concept gap, silly mistake or time pressure.

steps.title: Check the skipped ones
steps.detail: Some skipped questions were easy. Find them: that is free marks next time.

steps.title: Note the time sinks
steps.detail: List questions that took over two minutes and learn a faster method for each.

steps.title: Redo, then retest
steps.detail: Redo the wrong ones today, and again a few days later.

content.saveLine: Send it to a friend who takes mocks but never reviews them.
